original.description: Cases28PPG2000,80DI WATER and112A5 already contain useful nominal material/preparation facts. Their exact product/structure, water preparation routing, or normalized copper-formulation questions remain distinct. current_decision.reasoning: NBRC1400 names polypropylene glycol2000 and prepares an emulsion by sonication. The2000 denotes a nominal polymer-molecular-weight grade, not one molecule; it does not identify chain-length distribution or end-group/product specification. Polyethylene glycol2000 is chemically different.
